objects.description: Tagged as a union for 1D/2D/3D/4D coordinates and related views. Used across the API to pass coordinates by value or arrays. Provides multiple field layouts and a raw 4-double vector.

objects.definition: struct PJ_AREA;
objects.description: Opaque area-of-interest descriptor used when creating CRS-to-CRS operations. Contents hidden in this header.
Projection scale/angle distortion factors and first derivatives at a location. Returned by proj_factors().

objects.definition: struct PJconsts;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a PROJ object: projections, transformations, or ISO19111 objects. Lifecycled with proj_create* and proj_destroy.
Library-level info: version numbers, release strings, and search paths. Returned by proj_info().
Information about a specific projection/transformation instance.
Metadata about a grid file used by transformations, including extents and resolution.
Metadata for init files (legacy). Returned by proj_init_info().
List node describing a projection/operation plugin entry (name, constructor, description).
Static description of an ellipsoid entry: identifiers and parameters as strings.
Static description of a unit entry, including computed to-meter factor.
Static description of prime meridian definitions (offsets from Greenwich).
4D cartesian with time.
Generic 3D + time tuple (u,v,w,t).
Longitude, latitude, height, time.
Rotation angles: omega, phi, kappa.
Local East, North, Up components.
Geodesic result: distance and forward/reverse azimuths.
Generic 2D pair (u,v).
Cartesian 2D (x,y).
Angular 2D (longitude, latitude) in radians.
Cartesian 3D.
Generic 3D tuple (u,v,w).
Angular 3D (lon,lat,height).

objects.definition: struct pj_ctx;
objects.description: Opaque context object for thread-safety and configuration. Create/destroy/clone via proj_context_*().
Direction of transformation: forward, inverse or identity.
Verbosity levels for logging.

objects.definition: typedef struct PROJ_FILE_HANDLE PROJ_FILE_HANDLE;
objects.description: Opaque handle type for user-provided file API callbacks.
Callback vtable to override file I/O used by PROJ.

objects.definition: typedef struct PROJ_NETWORK_HANDLE PROJ_NETWORK_HANDLE;
objects.description: Opaque handle for network I/O callbacks.

objects.definition: typedef char **PROJ_STRING_LIST;
objects.description: NULL-terminated array of C strings used by various listing functions.
Enumeration describing guessed WKT dialect.
High-level object categories in the database.

Criteria to compare objects for equivalence.
WKT formatting conventions.

objects.description: Types of coordinate systems supported.
Descriptive record for a CRS entry from the database. Allocated and returned by listing functions.
Optional filters to query CRS lists from the database.
Describes a unit of measure retrieved from the database.
Describes a celestial body entry (e.g., Earth).

objects.definition: typedef struct PJ_OBJ_LIST PJ_OBJ_LIST;
objects.description: Opaque container holding a list of PJ objects returned by search/list APIs.

objects.definition: typedef struct PJ_INSERT_SESSION PJ_INSERT_SESSION;
objects.description: Opaque handle for building SQL INSERT statements for objects.

objects.definition: typedef struct PJ_OPERATION_FACTORY_CONTEXT PJ_OPERATION_FACTORY_CONTEXT;
objects.description: Opaque context configuring how operations are discovered between CRS pairs.
Kinds of unit of measure used in axis/parameter descriptions.
Axis descriptor used when programmatically creating coordinate systems.
Predefined 2D Cartesian CS axis order variants.
Predefined 2D ellipsoidal CS axis orders.
Predefined 3D ellipsoidal CS axis orders.
Parameter/value descriptor used to build Conversion/Transformation objects.
Root polymorphic base class for many PROJ util types, providing shared-from-this behavior via BaseObjectNNPtr and holding a PIMPL Private struct.
Non-null shared-pointer wrapper specifically for BaseObject, derived from util::nn<std::shared_ptr<...>>. Primarily an alias with an out-of-line dtor.
Interface for equivalence comparison across objects with adjustable criteria. Implementers provide _isEquivalentTo; isEquivalentTo offers the public API.
Object wrapper that boxes one of: string, int, or bool. Provides type tag and value accessors. Uses pimpl for storage.
Container of non-null BaseObject shared pointers with add() and iteration helpers; factory create() returns non-null shared ptr.
Map-like helper specialized for string keys to BaseObject values, with overloads to set primitive types that are internally boxed. PIMPL-managed.
Abstract base for names within a namespace model. Provides scope(), string form, and ability to obtain a fully qualified name.
Represents a naming scope/domain. Knows if it is the global namespace, its own qualified name, separator, and exposes a static GLOBAL instance.
Concrete GenericName representing a single identifier within a NameSpace. Provides scope and string conversion; construction via friends/factory.
Factory with static helpers to build NameSpace, LocalName, and composite GenericName instances from names and properties.
Abstract pattern emulating an extensible enumeration identified by a string name. Comparable by name and convertible to string.
Root exception class for util namespace, storing a message and overriding what().
Exception thrown when a PropertyMap key is set or retrieved with an incompatible value type.
Exception indicating the requested operation is not supported.

Marker struct used to denote that a pointer/nullability precondition has been externally validated. Instances of this tag are passed to nn constructors to bypass null checks. The header also defines a single constexpr value i_promise_i_checked_for_null.

Trait template that maps a pointer-like type to its pointee type via nested typedef element_type or raw-pointer partial specialization. This is a helper for nn to deduce element_type. Note: This is a class template, not intended for direct instantiation; the canonical pointer type here is symbolic since templates are not concrete types until specialized.

Primary non-nullable pointer wrapper template. It enforces non-null invariants for raw pointers and standard/user smart pointers. Construction from raw or smart pointers is disallowed directly; use the tag-dispatched constructors via i_promise_i_checked_for_null or the NN_CHECK_* macros/helpers. Supports pointer-like operators, conversions back to the underlying pointer type, comparisons, and get() for smart pointers. Aliases nn_unique_ptr<T> and nn_shared_ptr<T> are provided as nn<std::unique_ptr<T>> and nn<std::shared_ptr<T>>.

Type trait that evaluates to true for nn<...> instantiations and false otherwise. Provided as a struct template inheriting from std::integral_constant via std::true_type/false_type. Template-only utility.

CRTP helper class that augments std::enable_shared_from_this to return non-nullable shared pointers (nn_shared_ptr<T>) via nn_shared_from_this() const/non-const. Inherit when you want non-nullable shared_from_this results.
Standard hash specialization enabling hashing of nn<T> by delegating to std::hash<T> applied to the underlying nullable pointer. Template-only utility.
Alias template for a non-nullable unique_ptr packaged as nn<std::unique_ptr<T>>.
Alias template for a non-nullable shared_ptr packaged as nn<std::shared_ptr<T>>.

functions.name: proj_context_create
functions.description: Create and return a new PROJ execution context for thread-safe operations and configuration scoping. Typical usage is to create a context at the beginning of a workflow and pass it to other API calls that accept a context pointer.
requirements: Must be paired with proj_context_destroy() to avoid resource leaks.
Return value must be checked for NULL on allocation failure before further use.
The returned PJ_CONTEXT* is opaque and must only be used with PROJ APIs.

functions.name: proj_context_destroy
functions.description: Destroy/free a PJ_CONTEXT previously created with proj_context_create(). Returns a pointer (historically may return the default context or NULL depending on implementation), but callers should treat the context as invalid after this call.
requirements: ctx may be NULL (no-op) depending on implementation, but passing an invalid pointer is undefined.
Must not be used after being destroyed.
Should only be called once per created context.

functions.name: proj_context_clone
functions.description: Clone an existing PJ_CONTEXT, copying its configuration. Useful to create a similar context for another thread or task.
requirements: ctx should be a valid PJ_CONTEXT* (non-NULL).
Return value must be checked for NULL before use.
Cloned context must be destroyed with proj_context_destroy().

functions.name: proj_context_set_file_finder
functions.description: Register a callback to resolve a filename to a full path for resource loading. The callback can use user_data to carry state.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
finder may be NULL to clear a previous callback (behavior inferred).
finder callbacks must be reentrant/thread-safe if used concurrently.
user_data is passed verbatim to the callback and must remain valid while the callback may be invoked.

functions.name: proj_context_set_search_paths
functions.signature: void proj_context_set_search_paths(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, int count_paths, const char *const *paths);
functions.description: Set the list of directories to be searched for PROJ resource files (grids, database, etc.).
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
paths must point to an array of count_paths C strings. Each string must be NUL-terminated and valid for the duration of the call (and, depending on implementation, until changed).
count_paths must be >= 0.
Paths should be absolute or otherwise meaningful to the consuming file resolver.

functions.name: proj_context_set_ca_bundle_path
functions.description: Set the file path to a CA certificate bundle used for HTTPS/TLS operations (e.g., network grid downloads).
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
path must be a valid NUL-terminated string to an accessible CA bundle file, or possibly NULL to clear (behavior inferred).
The file should be readable by the process.

functions.name: proj_context_use_proj4_init_rules
functions.description: Enable or disable legacy PROJ.4 init file behavior for parsing definitions. Marked in Doxygen-suppressed section; primarily for compatibility.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
enable should be 0 (disable) or non-zero (enable).
Affects how init= references are resolved; callers must ensure desired behavior for legacy pipelines.

functions.name: proj_context_get_use_proj4_init_rules
functions.description: Query whether legacy PROJ.4 init rules are in effect. The from_legacy_code_path flag is used internally to adapt behavior based on call site origin.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
from_legacy_code_path should be 0 or 1.

functions.name: proj_context_set_fileapi
functions.description: Install a custom file I/O backend (open/read/write/seek/tell/close/exists/mkdir/unlink/rename) for resource access. Enables embedding or sandboxing by redirecting file access through callbacks.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
fileapi must be a valid pointer to a PROJ_FILE_API structure with version set appropriately (currently 1) and required callbacks non-NULL per intended use.
Callbacks must obey their specified contracts and be thread-safe if PROJ is used concurrently.
user_data will be passed to all callbacks and must remain valid as long as the callbacks may be invoked.
Returns non-zero on success (exact semantics depend on implementation). Check return value.

functions.name: proj_context_set_sqlite3_vfs_name
functions.description: Specify the SQLite3 VFS name to be used by PROJ's database layer (e.g., for custom I/O or sandboxed environments).
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
name must be a NUL-terminated string naming an available SQLite VFS, or NULL to reset to default (behavior inferred).

functions.name: proj_context_set_network_callbacks
functions.signature: int proj_context_set_network_callbacks(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, proj_network_open_cbk_type open_cbk, proj_network_close_cbk_type close_cbk, proj_network_get_header_value_cbk_type get_header_value_cbk, proj_network_read_range_type read_range_cbk, void *user_data);
functions.description: Install network I/O callbacks used by PROJ to fetch remote resources (e.g., grids). The open callback should also capture HTTP headers for later retrieval.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
All function pointers provided for the intended operations must be non-NULL and conform to their documented semantics (including offset/size handling and error reporting).
Callbacks must be thread-safe if used concurrently.
open_cbk must fill out_size_read and may write initial bytes to buffer; it should store response headers for get_header_value_cbk.
read_range_cbk must return the number of bytes actually read and fill error message if needed.
user_data must remain valid for the lifetime of callback usage.
Returns non-zero on success. Always check return value.

functions.name: proj_context_set_enable_network
functions.description: Enable or disable PROJ's use of network access for resource fetching within the given context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
enabled should be 0 to disable, non-zero to enable.
Returns non-zero on success; check return value.

functions.name: proj_context_is_network_enabled
functions.description: Return whether network access is currently enabled in the context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
Return value is an integer treated as boolean: non-zero enabled, zero disabled.

functions.name: proj_context_set_url_endpoint
functions.description: Set the base URL endpoint used by PROJ when downloading resources (e.g., CDN or mirror).
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
url must be a valid NUL-terminated string representing a base HTTP/HTTPS URL.

functions.name: proj_context_get_url_endpoint
functions.description: Get the current base URL endpoint used for network resource downloads in this context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
Returned pointer is owned by PROJ and must not be freed or modified by the caller and is valid at least until context settings change.

functions.name: proj_context_get_user_writable_directory
functions.description: Return the user-writable directory path for this context, optionally creating it.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
create should be 0 or non-zero; when non-zero, implementation may attempt to create the directory if it does not exist.
Returned string is owned by PROJ and must not be freed or modified by the caller.

functions.name: proj_context_set_user_writable_directory
functions.description: Override the user-writable directory path for the context, optionally creating it.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
path must be a valid NUL-terminated directory path.
create should be 0 or non-zero; when non-zero, implementation may attempt to create the directory.

functions.name: proj_grid_cache_set_enable
functions.description: Enable or disable the on-disk/in-memory grid cache mechanism used by PROJ for grid resources.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
enabled should be 0 to disable, non-zero to enable.

functions.name: proj_grid_cache_set_filename
functions.description: Set the filename/path used for caching downloaded grids.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
fullname must be a valid NUL-terminated path to a file used by the cache subsystem. The directory should be writable.

functions.name: proj_grid_cache_set_max_size
functions.description: Set the maximum cache size for grid data, in megabytes.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
max_size_MB should be >= 0 (units: megabytes).

functions.name: proj_grid_cache_set_ttl
functions.description: Set the time-to-live (TTL) in seconds for cached grid entries before they are considered stale.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
ttl_seconds should be >= 0 (0 may mean no caching or immediate expiry depending on implementation).

functions.name: proj_grid_cache_clear
functions.description: Clear/flush the current grid cache for the given context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
May require appropriate filesystem permissions if the cache is on disk.

functions.name: proj_is_download_needed
functions.signature: int proj_is_download_needed(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *url_or_filename, int ignore_ttl_setting);
functions.description: Check whether a given remote URL or local filename needs to be (re-)downloaded, taking into account cache presence and TTL unless ignored.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
url_or_filename must be a valid NUL-terminated string.
ignore_ttl_setting should be 0 or non-zero; non-zero forces ignoring TTL when deciding.
Returns non-zero if a download is needed, zero otherwise; check result.

functions.name: proj_download_file
functions.signature: int proj_download_file(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *url_or_filename, int ignore_ttl_setting, int (*progress_cbk)(PJ_CONTEXT *, double pct, void *user_data), void *user_data);
functions.description: Download a resource identified by URL or filename as needed, honoring or ignoring TTL. Optionally reports progress via a callback receiving percentage updates.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
url_or_filename must be a valid NUL-terminated URL or filename.
ignore_ttl_setting should be 0 or non-zero.
progress_cbk may be NULL to disable progress reporting; if non-NULL it must be reentrant/thread-safe and accept pct in [0,100].
user_data is passed through to progress_cbk and must remain valid for the duration of the download.
Returns non-zero on success; check return value.

functions.name: proj_create
functions.description: Create a PROJ operation/CRS object from a PROJ string definition (pipeline or operation).
requirements: ctx should be a valid PJ_CONTEXT* (can be NULL for default context depending on build).
definition must be a valid NUL-terminated PROJ string.
Return value must be checked for NULL on failure and destroyed with proj_destroy() when no longer needed.

functions.name: proj_create_argv
functions.description: Create a PROJ object from argc/argv style parameters (equivalent of parsing +key=value tokens).
requirements: ctx should be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
argc must be >= 0; argv must point to an array of argc pointers to NUL-terminated strings.
The created PJ* must be destroyed with proj_destroy().
Check for NULL return.

functions.name: proj_create_crs_to_crs
functions.signature: PJ *proj_create_crs_to_crs(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *source_crs, const char *target_crs, PJ_AREA *area);
functions.description: Create a coordinate operation that transforms between a source CRS and a target CRS, optionally constrained by an area of interest.
requirements: ctx should be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
source_crs and target_crs must be valid CRS identifiers/definitions (e.g., "EPSG:XXXX" or WKT/PROJ strings) as NUL-terminated strings.
area may be NULL or a PJ_AREA* created by proj_area_create() with bbox set as needed.
Must destroy returned object with proj_destroy().
Check for NULL return.

functions.name: proj_create_crs_to_crs_from_pj
functions.signature: PJ *proj_create_crs_to_crs_from_pj(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *source_crs, const PJ *target_crs, PJ_AREA *area, const char *const *options);
functions.description: Create a CRS-to-CRS coordinate operation from already constructed PJ objects representing the source and target CRS, with optional tuning options.
requirements: ctx should be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
source_crs and target_crs must be valid PJ* CRS objects (not NULL).
area may be NULL or a PJ_AREA* configured with proj_area_set_bbox().
options may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of option strings (exact keys are library-defined).
Destroy the returned PJ* with proj_destroy().
Check for NULL return.

functions.name: proj_normalize_for_visualization
functions.description: Return a transformation equivalent to obj but adapted for visualization purposes (e.g., turning longitude-latitude ordering into x-y in degrees).
requirements: ctx should be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ* operation/CRS object.
Returned PJ* must be destroyed with proj_destroy().
Check for NULL return.

functions.name: proj_assign_context
functions.description: Associate a PJ object with a given PJ_CONTEXT, overriding its current context association. Useful to rebind objects to a specific context.
requirements: pj must be a valid PJ* object.
ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT* (can be PJ_DEFAULT_CTX in C++ as nullptr where applicable).
Object should not be concurrently used across multiple contexts.

functions.name: proj_destroy
functions.description: Destroy/free a PJ object created by proj_create or related factory functions. Historically returns a pointer but the object must be considered invalid after the call.
requirements: P may be NULL (no-op) depending on implementation; passing an invalid pointer is undefined behavior.
Must not use P after destruction.
Call exactly once per created object.

functions.name: proj_area_create
functions.description: Allocate and return a new, empty area-of-interest object used to constrain operation selection.
requirements: Must be destroyed with proj_area_destroy() to avoid leaks.
Check for NULL return before use.

functions.name: proj_area_set_bbox
functions.signature: void proj_area_set_bbox(PJ_AREA *area, double west_lon_degree, double south_lat_degree, double east_lon_degree, double north_lat_degree);
functions.description: Set the bounding box (in degrees) of an area-of-interest object, using geographic coordinates.
requirements: area must be a valid PJ_AREA*.
Longitudes are in degrees and typically in the range [-180, 180] or [0,360]; latitudes in [-90, 90] (inference based on naming).
west_lon_degree must be <= east_lon_degree and south_lat_degree must be <= north_lat_degree to define a valid bbox.

functions.name: proj_area_set_name
functions.description: Set an optional name for the area-of-interest object.
requirements: area must be a valid PJ_AREA*.
name must be a valid NUL-terminated string (or NULL to clear, inferred).

functions.name: proj_area_destroy
functions.description: Free an area-of-interest object previously created with proj_area_create().
requirements: area may be NULL (no-op) depending on implementation.
Do not use area after destruction.

functions.name: proj_angular_input
functions.description: Report whether the specified input (forward or inverse) of the operation expects angular units for coordinates.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
dir must be one of PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.
Returns non-zero if input is angular, zero otherwise.

functions.name: proj_angular_output
functions.description: Report whether the specified output (forward or inverse) of the operation yields angular units for coordinates.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
dir must be PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.
Returns non-zero if output is angular, zero otherwise.

functions.name: proj_degree_input
functions.description: Report whether the specified input expects degrees (as opposed to radians) for angular coordinates.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
dir must be PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.
Returns non-zero if degrees, zero otherwise.

functions.name: proj_degree_output
functions.description: Report whether the specified output yields degrees (as opposed to radians) for angular coordinates.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
dir must be PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.
Returns non-zero if degrees, zero otherwise.

functions.name: proj_trans
functions.signature: PJ_COORD proj_trans(PJ *P, PJ_DIRECTION direction, PJ_COORD coord);
functions.description: Transform a single coordinate using operation P in the given direction (forward, inverse, or identity).
requirements: P must be a valid transform-capable PJ* object (e.g., pipeline or coordinate operation).
direction must be PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.
coord must be initialized (components relevant to P filled appropriately).
Errors are reported through context/PJ errno; caller should check proj_errno(P) or context errno on suspicious results.

functions.name: proj_trans_get_last_used_operation
functions.description: Return the last concrete operation actually used during the most recent proj_trans/proj_trans_array/proj_trans_generic call on P (e.g., a step within a pipeline).
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
Returned PJ* is owned by PROJ; do not destroy it (inferred typical pattern).
May return NULL if not applicable.

functions.name: proj_trans_array
functions.signature: int proj_trans_array(PJ *P, PJ_DIRECTION direction, size_t n, PJ_COORD *coord);
functions.description: Transform an array of n coordinates in place.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ* transform-capable object.
direction must be PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.
coord must point to an array of at least n PJ_COORD elements.
Returns 0 on success (inference: check documentation at runtime); caller should check return value and/or proj_errno(P) for errors.

functions.name: proj_trans_generic
functions.signature: size_t proj_trans_generic(PJ *P, PJ_DIRECTION direction, double *x, size_t sx, size_t nx, double *y, size_t sy, size_t ny, double *z, size_t sz, size_t nz, double *t, size_t st, size_t nt);
functions.description: Generic batched transform over strided arrays of x/y/z/t components. Allows transforming interleaved or separate arrays by specifying strides and counts per component.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ* transform-capable object.
direction must be PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.

For each component pointer (x,y,z,t): if non-NULL, it must point to a buffer large enough for nx/ny/nz/nt elements with byte strides sx/sy/sz/st measured in sizeof(double) units (strides are in element counts, as type is size_t).
Counts nx/ny/nz/nt must be consistent with provided buffers. Any of the component pointers may be NULL if count is zero.
Returns the number of successfully transformed points (implementation-defined). Caller should check proj_errno(P) for partial failures.

functions.name: proj_trans_bounds
functions.signature: int proj_trans_bounds(PJ_CONTEXT *context, PJ *P, PJ_DIRECTION direction, double xmin, double ymin, double xmax, double ymax, double *out_xmin, double *out_ymin, double *out_xmax, double *out_ymax, int densify_pts);
functions.description: Transform an axis-aligned 2D bounding box between coordinate systems by sampling along edges and interior with optional densification to account for warping, returning a tight bounding box in the target space.
requirements: context must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
P must be a valid PJ* transform-capable object.
direction must be PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.
Input xmin <= xmax and ymin <= ymax should hold.
Output pointers out_xmin/out_ymin/out_xmax/out_ymax must be non-NULL.
densify_pts controls intermediate sampling; should be >= 0.
Returns 0/1 depending on success (implementation-defined).

functions.name: proj_trans_bounds_3D
functions.signature: int proj_trans_bounds_3D(PJ_CONTEXT *context, PJ *P, PJ_DIRECTION direction, const double xmin, const double ymin, const double zmin, const double xmax, const double ymax, const double zmax, double *out_xmin, double *out_ymin, double *out_zmin, double *out_xmax, double *out_ymax, double *out_zmax, const int densify_pts);
functions.description: 3D variant of proj_trans_bounds. Transforms a 3D axis-aligned bounding box with optional densification to estimate a tight bounding box in target space.
requirements: context must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
P must be a valid PJ* transform-capable object.
direction must be PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.
Require xmin <= xmax, ymin <= ymax, zmin <= zmax.
All out_* pointers must be non-NULL.
densify_pts should be >= 0.
Returns implementation-defined integer status; check return value.

functions.name: proj_coord
functions.signature: PJ_COORD proj_coord(double x, double y, double z, double t);
functions.description: Helper constructor for a PJ_COORD value from four doubles (x/y/z/t).
requirements: Inputs should be finite doubles as required by the operation consuming the coordinate.

functions.name: proj_roundtrip
functions.signature: double proj_roundtrip(PJ *P, PJ_DIRECTION direction, int n, PJ_COORD *coord);
functions.description: Measure internal consistency by applying a forward and inverse transformation (or vice versa) on n coordinates and returning an aggregate error (e.g., maximum discrepancy).
requirements: P must be a valid PJ* transform-capable object with both forward and inverse available.
direction must be PJ_FWD or PJ_INV to define initial direction.
n must be >= 0; coord must point to at least n PJ_COORD.
Return value is a non-negative error measure; exact definition is implementation-defined.

functions.name: proj_lp_dist
functions.signature: double proj_lp_dist(const PJ *P, PJ_COORD a, PJ_COORD b);
functions.description: Compute geodesic distance between two angular 2D coordinates on the ellipsoid of P, in meters.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ* (its ellipsoid parameters will be used).
a and b must contain longitude/latitude in radians in their angular fields (union members).

functions.name: proj_lpz_dist
functions.signature: double proj_lpz_dist(const PJ *P, PJ_COORD a, PJ_COORD b);
functions.description: Compute the geodesic distance between two angular coordinates and include vertical offset contribution; returns a combined distance (details depend on implementation).
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
a and b must have longitude/latitude in radians and a vertical component.

functions.name: proj_xy_dist
functions.description: Compute Euclidean distance between two linear 2D points (x,y).
requirements: a and b should be provided with xy members meaningful in the same linear units.

functions.name: proj_xyz_dist
functions.description: Compute Euclidean distance between two linear 3D points (x,y,z).
requirements: a and b should be provided with xyz members meaningful in the same units.

functions.name: proj_geod
functions.signature: PJ_COORD proj_geod(const PJ *P, PJ_COORD a, PJ_COORD b);
functions.description: Solve the inverse geodesic problem between two points on the ellipsoid of P, returning geodesic length (m) and forward/reverse azimuths (rad) in the PJ_COORD.geod fields.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ* with ellipsoid defined.
a and b must carry longitude and latitude in radians.

functions.name: proj_geod_direct
functions.signature: PJ_COORD proj_geod_direct(const PJ *P, PJ_COORD a, double azimuth, double distance);
functions.description: Solve the direct geodesic problem on the ellipsoid of P: from starting point a (lon/lat in radians), initial azimuth (rad clockwise from true north) and distance (meters), compute destination lon/lat (rad) and forward azimuth at destination (rad).
requirements: P must be a valid PJ* (CRS or transform) with ellipsoid parameters.
a must contain longitude and latitude in radians (axis order of P is ignored; always use lon,lat).
azimuth in radians; distance in meters.
Returned PJ_COORD stores (lon, lat, fwd_azimuth, t unused).

functions.name: proj_context_errno
functions.description: Get the last error code stored in the given context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
Return is a PROJ error code; may be 0 for no error.

functions.name: proj_errno
functions.description: Get the last error code associated with a PJ object.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
Return is a PROJ error code; may be 0 for no error.

functions.name: proj_errno_set
functions.description: Set the error code associated with a PJ object to the specified value.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
err should be a defined PROJ error code or 0.
Returns previous or new error code (implementation-defined).

functions.name: proj_errno_reset
functions.description: Reset the error code associated with the PJ object to 0.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
Return value is implementation-defined (previous code or 0).

functions.name: proj_errno_restore
functions.description: Restore the error code associated with a PJ object to err.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
err should be a valid PROJ error code or 0.

functions.name: proj_errno_string
functions.description: Deprecated: return a human-readable string for an error code. Use proj_context_errno_string() instead.
requirements: err should be a PROJ error code.
Returned pointer must not be modified or freed; lifetime is library-managed.

functions.name: proj_context_errno_string
functions.description: Return a human-readable string for an error code, potentially localized/configured by ctx.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
err should be a PROJ error code.
Returned pointer must not be modified or freed.

functions.name: proj_log_level
functions.description: Get or set the log verbosity level for the context. Typically returns previous level when setting.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
log_level must be a valid PJ_LOG_LEVEL enum value.

functions.name: proj_log_func
functions.description: Register a logging callback for the context. Messages of level >= current log level will be forwarded to logf with app_data.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
logf may be NULL to clear logging callback (inferred).
logf must be thread-safe if logs can be emitted from multiple threads.
app_data is passed verbatim and must remain valid while callback can be invoked.

functions.name: proj_factors
functions.description: Compute scaling and angular distortion factors (Tissot indicatrix and derivatives) at a given angular coordinate for the projection P.
requirements: P must be a valid PJ* projection object.
lp must contain angular coordinates (typically longitude/latitude) in radians.

functions.name: proj_info
functions.description: Return information about the PROJ library build and configuration (version numbers, search paths, etc.).
requirements: No inputs.
Returned struct is by value; its string members are library-managed and must not be freed.

functions.name: proj_pj_info
functions.description: Return information about a specific projection object P (id, description, definition, has_inverse, accuracy).
requirements: P must be a valid PJ*.
Returned struct is by value; any internal strings are library-managed and must not be freed.

functions.name: proj_grid_info
functions.description: Return information about a grid resource by its short name.
requirements: gridname must be a valid NUL-terminated grid identifier.
Returned struct is by value.

functions.name: proj_init_info
functions.description: Return information about an init file by name (version, origin, last update, etc.).
requirements: initname must be a valid NUL-terminated init file identifier.
Returned struct is by value.

functions.name: proj_list_operations
functions.description: Return a pointer to an array of known projection operations metadata (id, entry point, description), typically terminated by a sentinel. Mainly for enumeration/discovery.
requirements: Returned pointer must not be freed; lifetime is library-managed.
Array termination/sentinel convention must be respected when iterating.

functions.name: proj_list_ellps
functions.description: Return a pointer to an array of known ellipsoids (id, parameters, name), for enumeration.
requirements: Returned pointer must not be freed; lifetime is library-managed.
Array is typically sentinel-terminated.

functions.name: proj_list_units
functions.description: Deprecated: Return a pointer to an array of legacy linear units. Prefer proj_get_units_from_database().
requirements: Returned pointer is library-managed; do not free.

functions.name: proj_list_angular_units
functions.description: Deprecated: Return a pointer to an array of legacy angular units. Prefer proj_get_units_from_database().
requirements: Returned pointer is library-managed; do not free.

functions.name: proj_list_prime_meridians
functions.description: Return a pointer to an array of known prime meridians (id, definition).
requirements: Returned pointer must not be freed; lifetime is library-managed.
Array is typically sentinel-terminated.

functions.name: proj_torad
functions.description: Convert degrees to radians.
requirements: Input is interpreted in degrees.
Return is in radians.

functions.name: proj_todeg
functions.description: Convert radians to degrees.
requirements: Input is interpreted in radians.
Return is in degrees.

functions.name: proj_dmstor
functions.description: Parse a DMS (degrees/minutes/seconds) string into radians. Optionally returns a pointer to first unparsed character via rs.
requirements: is must be a valid NUL-terminated DMS string.
rs may be NULL or a valid pointer to receive the end pointer.
Return is in radians.

functions.name: proj_rtodms
functions.signature: char *proj_rtodms(char *s, double r, int pos, int neg);
functions.description: Deprecated: Format an angle in radians r into a DMS string into buffer s, using pos/neg characters for hemisphere/sign. Prefer proj_rtodms2().
requirements: s must point to a writable buffer large enough for the formatted string.
r is in radians.
pos and neg are characters (e.g., 'N'/'S', 'E'/'W').

functions.name: proj_rtodms2
functions.signature: char *proj_rtodms2(char *s, size_t sizeof_s, double r, int pos, int neg);
functions.description: Format an angle in radians r into a DMS string into buffer s of given size, using pos/neg characters for hemisphere/sign. Safer version with explicit buffer size.
requirements: s must point to a writable buffer of at least sizeof_s bytes.
sizeof_s must be > 0.
r is in radians.
pos and neg are characters for positive/negative hemispheres.

functions.name: proj_cleanup
functions.description: Cleanup internal PROJ global resources/caches. Typically not needed in normal processes; mainly for leak checkers or controlled shutdown.
requirements: May affect global state and caches; should generally be called once at program termination if at all.
Not thread-safe to call concurrently with active PROJ operations.

functions.name: proj_string_list_destroy
functions.description: Destroy a NULL-terminated list of C strings returned by certain PROJ APIs.
requirements: list may be NULL (no-op).
Only free lists obtained from PROJ; do not use on arbitrary data.

functions.name: proj_context_set_autoclose_database
functions.description: Enable/disable automatic closing of the database connection when not in use in this context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
autoclose should be 0 or non-zero.

functions.name: proj_context_set_database_path
functions.signature: int proj_context_set_database_path(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *dbPath, const char *const *auxDbPaths, const char *const *options);
functions.description: Set the main PROJ database path and optional auxiliary database paths, with optional configuration options.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
dbPath must be a valid NUL-terminated path to a SQLite database file.
auxDbPaths may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of additional database paths.
options may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of option strings.
Returns non-zero on success; check return value.

functions.name: proj_context_get_database_path
functions.description: Get the current database path used by the context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
Returned pointer is library-managed; do not free or modify.

functions.name: proj_context_get_database_metadata
functions.description: Query a metadata value from the database by key (e.g., version).
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
key must be a valid NUL-terminated string.
Returned pointer is library-managed and may be NULL if key not found.

functions.name: proj_context_get_database_structure
functions.description: Return a NULL-terminated list of strings describing the database structure. Options can tune output.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
options may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of option strings.
Caller must free the returned list with proj_string_list_destroy().

functions.name: proj_context_guess_wkt_dialect
functions.description: Guess the WKT dialect of a WKT string (WKT2, WKT1 GDAL/ESRI, or not WKT).
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
wkt must be a valid NUL-terminated string containing WKT.
Return is a PJ_GUESSED_WKT_DIALECT enum.

functions.name: proj_create_from_wkt
functions.signature: PJ *proj_create_from_wkt(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *wkt, const char *const *options, PROJ_STRING_LIST *out_warnings, PROJ_STRING_LIST *out_grammar_errors);
functions.description: Create a PJ object by parsing a WKT string. Optionally returns lists of warnings and grammar errors.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
wkt must be a valid NUL-terminated WKT string.
options may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of option strings.
out_warnings and out_grammar_errors may be NULL or non-NULL pointers to receive allocated string lists (caller must free with proj_string_list_destroy()).
Check for NULL return and destroy PJ* with proj_destroy() when done.

functions.name: proj_create_from_database
functions.signature: PJ *proj_create_from_database(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *auth_name, const char *code, PJ_CATEGORY category, int usePROJAlternativeGridNames, const char *const *options);
functions.description: Create a PJ object from the PROJ database given authority name and code, optionally restricting by category and option flags.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
auth_name must be a valid authority name (e.g., "EPSG").
code must be a valid code string (e.g., "4326").
category selects the kind of object expected.
usePROJAlternativeGridNames is 0 or non-zero.
options may be NULL or a list of option strings.
Check for NULL return; destroy with proj_destroy().

functions.name: proj_uom_get_info_from_database
functions.signature: int proj_uom_get_info_from_database(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *auth_name, const char *code, const char **out_name, double *out_conv_factor, const char **out_category);
functions.description: Retrieve information about a unit of measure from the database: its name, conversion factor to SI, and category.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
auth_name and code must be valid NUL-terminated strings.
out_name, out_conv_factor, out_category may be NULL or valid pointers to receive results. Any non-NULL out parameter must be writable.
Returns non-zero on success; check return value.
Returned strings are library-managed; do not free.

functions.name: proj_grid_get_info_from_database
functions.signature: int proj_grid_get_info_from_database(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *grid_name, const char **out_full_name, const char **out_package_name, const char **out_url, int *out_direct_download, int *out_open_license, int *out_available);
functions.description: Retrieve metadata about a grid resource from the database, including full name, package, URL, and availability/download flags.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
grid_name must be a valid NUL-terminated string.
Output pointers may be NULL or valid pointers to receive values. Any non-NULL must be writable.
Returned string pointers are library-managed; do not free.
Returns non-zero on success; check return value.

functions.name: proj_clone
functions.description: Clone a PJ object into the given context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ* object.
Returned PJ* must be destroyed with proj_destroy().
Check for NULL return.

functions.name: proj_create_from_name
functions.signature: PJ_OBJ_LIST *proj_create_from_name(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *auth_name, const char *searchedName, const PJ_TYPE *types, size_t typesCount, int approximateMatch, size_t limitResultCount, const char *const *options);
functions.description: Search the database for objects by name and type(s), returning a list of matches.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
auth_name may be NULL to search all authorities or a specific one.
searchedName must be a NUL-terminated search string.
types may be NULL or point to an array of types with typesCount elements.
approximateMatch is 0 or non-zero to allow fuzzy matching.
limitResultCount caps number of results.
options may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of option strings.
Returned list must be destroyed with proj_list_destroy().

functions.name: proj_get_type
functions.description: Return the object type (e.g., CRS, transformation, ellipsoid, etc.).
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.

functions.name: proj_is_deprecated
functions.description: Return whether the object is deprecated (non-zero) per the authority database.
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.
Return is integer treated as boolean.

functions.name: proj_get_non_deprecated
functions.description: Return a list of non-deprecated objects equivalent to the provided object.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ*.
Returned list must be destroyed with proj_list_destroy().
Check for NULL return.

functions.name: proj_is_equivalent_to
functions.signature: int proj_is_equivalent_to(const PJ *obj, const PJ *other, PJ_COMPARISON_CRITERION criterion);
functions.description: Test equivalence of two objects according to a comparison criterion (strict, equivalent, equivalent except axis order).
requirements: obj and other must be valid PJ* objects.
criterion must be a valid PJ_COMPARISON_CRITERION.
Returns non-zero if equivalent per criterion, zero otherwise.

functions.name: proj_is_equivalent_to_with_ctx
functions.signature: int proj_is_equivalent_to_with_ctx(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *obj, const PJ *other, PJ_COMPARISON_CRITERION criterion);
functions.description: Context-aware variant of proj_is_equivalent_to(), potentially using database access or options from ctx.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj and other must be valid PJ* objects.
criterion must be valid.
Check returned boolean.

functions.name: proj_is_crs
functions.description: Return non-zero if the object is of a CRS type.
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.

functions.name: proj_get_name
functions.description: Get the human-readable name of the object.
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.
Returned pointer is library-managed; do not free. May be NULL.

functions.name: proj_get_id_auth_name
functions.description: Get the authority name of the identifier at the given index for the object.
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.
index must be >= 0 and within the number of identifiers.
Returned pointer is library-managed; do not free. May be NULL.

functions.name: proj_get_id_code
functions.description: Get the code of the identifier at the given index for the object.
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.
index must be >= 0 and within range.
Returned pointer is library-managed; do not free. May be NULL.

functions.name: proj_get_remarks
functions.description: Get remarks associated with the object, if any.
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.
Returned pointer is library-managed; do not free. May be NULL.

functions.name: proj_get_domain_count
functions.description: Get the number of applicability domains (areas/scopes) defined for the object.
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.
Returns >= 0.

functions.name: proj_get_scope
functions.description: Get the scope text of the object (general statement of intended usage).
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.
Returned pointer is library-managed; do not free. May be NULL.

functions.name: proj_get_scope_ex
functions.description: Get the scope text for a specific domain index.
requirements: obj must be a valid PJ*.
domainIdx must be in [0, proj_get_domain_count(obj)).
Returned pointer is library-managed; do not free. May be NULL.

functions.name: proj_get_area_of_use
functions.signature: int proj_get_area_of_use(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *obj, double *out_west_lon_degree, double *out_south_lat_degree, double *out_east_lon_degree, double *out_north_lat_degree, const char **out_area_name);
functions.description: Get the area-of-use bounding box (degrees) and optional name for the object.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ*.
Any non-NULL out_* pointer must be writable. out_area_name, if requested, is library-managed; do not free.
Returns non-zero on success; check return value.

functions.name: proj_get_area_of_use_ex
functions.signature: int proj_get_area_of_use_ex(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *obj, int domainIdx, double *out_west_lon_degree, double *out_south_lat_degree, double *out_east_lon_degree, double *out_north_lat_degree, const char **out_area_name);
functions.description: Get the area-of-use for a specific domain index.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ*.
domainIdx must be valid.
Output pointers same rules as proj_get_area_of_use().
Returns non-zero on success.

functions.name: proj_as_wkt
functions.signature: const char *proj_as_wkt(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *obj, PJ_WKT_TYPE type, const char *const *options);
functions.description: Export an object to a WKT string of the requested WKT version/convention. The returned string is library-managed.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ*.
type must be a valid PJ_WKT_TYPE.
options may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of option strings.
Returned pointer must not be freed; its lifetime is tied to ctx/object and may change on next call.

functions.name: proj_as_proj_string
functions.signature: const char *proj_as_proj_string(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *obj, PJ_PROJ_STRING_TYPE type, const char *const *options);
functions.description: Export an object to a PROJ string (PROJ 5/4 style) with options.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ*.
type must be a valid PJ_PROJ_STRING_TYPE.
options may be NULL or a list of option strings.
Returned pointer must not be freed; lifetime is library-managed.

functions.name: proj_as_projjson
functions.signature: const char *proj_as_projjson(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *obj, const char *const *options);
functions.description: Export an object to a PROJJSON string.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ*.
options may be NULL or list of option strings.
Returned pointer must not be freed.

functions.name: proj_get_source_crs
functions.description: Get the source CRS from a coordinate operation object.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ* coordinate operation.
Returned PJ* must be destroyed with proj_destroy(). May be NULL.

functions.name: proj_get_target_crs
functions.description: Get the target CRS from a coordinate operation object.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ* coordinate operation.
Returned PJ* must be destroyed with proj_destroy(). May be NULL.

functions.name: proj_identify
functions.signature: PJ_OBJ_LIST *proj_identify(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *obj, const char *auth_name, const char *const *options, int **out_confidence);
functions.description: Identify the best matching database object(s) corresponding to obj, optionally constrained by authority, returning a list and per-result confidence values.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
obj must be a valid PJ*.
auth_name may be NULL or a specific authority.
options may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list.
out_confidence may be NULL or a pointer to receive an array of ints sized to the result count; free rules follow proj_list_destroy() context (check library docs).
Returned list must be destroyed with proj_list_destroy().

functions.name: proj_get_geoid_models_from_database
functions.signature: PROJ_STRING_LIST proj_get_geoid_models_from_database(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *auth_name, const char *code, const char *const *options);
functions.description: Return a list of geoid model names related to a vertical CRS identified by authority and code.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
auth_name and code must be valid NUL-terminated strings.
options may be NULL or a list of option strings.
Caller must destroy the returned list with proj_string_list_destroy().

functions.name: proj_int_list_destroy
functions.description: Destroy an integer list returned by some PROJ APIs.
requirements: list may be NULL (no-op).
Only free lists obtained from PROJ.

functions.name: proj_get_authorities_from_database
functions.description: Returns a NULL-terminated list of authority names available in the current PROJ database attached to ctx.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT* (created by proj_context_create or provided by PROJ).
Returned list must be freed with proj_string_list_destroy().
Function may return NULL on error.

functions.name: proj_get_codes_from_database
functions.signature:
PROJ_STRING_LIST PROJ_DLL proj_get_codes_from_database(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx,
                                                       const char *auth_name,
                                                       PJ_TYPE type,
                                                       int allow_deprecated);
functions.description: Returns a NULL-terminated list of object codes for a given authority and PJ_TYPE in the current database.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
auth_name must be a valid, null-terminated string of an authority present in the database.
type selects the object type to list (see PJ_TYPE).
allow_deprecated controls inclusion of deprecated objects (non-zero to include).
Returned list must be freed with proj_string_list_destroy().
May return NULL on error or if no match.

functions.name: proj_get_celestial_body_list_from_database
functions.signature:
PROJ_CELESTIAL_BODY_INFO PROJ_DLL **proj_get_celestial_body_list_from_database(
    PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const char *auth_name, int *out_result_count);
functions.description: Retrieves an array of PROJ_CELESTIAL_BODY_INFO* entries describing celestial bodies from the database for the given authority.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
auth_name may be NULL (meaning all) or a valid authority name string.
out_result_count must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the number of returned entries.
Returned array must be freed with proj_celestial_body_list_destroy().
May return NULL on error or when none available (with out_result_count set to 0).

functions.name: proj_celestial_body_list_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a list returned by proj_get_celestial_body_list_from_database and frees associated resources.
requirements: list must be either NULL or a list previously returned by proj_get_celestial_body_list_from_database.
Do not use the list after destroying it.

functions.name: proj_get_crs_list_parameters_create
functions.description: Allocates and returns a parameter structure to control proj_get_crs_info_list_from_database().
requirements: Returned pointer must be released with proj_get_crs_list_parameters_destroy().

functions.name: proj_get_crs_list_parameters_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a PROJ_CRS_LIST_PARAMETERS previously created and frees resources.
requirements: params must be either NULL or a pointer returned by proj_get_crs_list_parameters_create().
Do not use params after destruction.

functions.name: proj_get_crs_info_list_from_database
functions.description: Queries the database for CRS entries and returns an array of PROJ_CRS_INFO* with summary information matching filters.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
auth_name may be NULL (no restriction) or a valid authority name.
params may be NULL (defaults) or a parameters object created by proj_get_crs_list_parameters_create().
out_result_count must be non-NULL to receive the number of entries.
Returned array must be freed with proj_crs_info_list_destroy().
May return NULL on error or if no result (with out_result_count set accordingly).

functions.name: proj_crs_info_list_destroy
functions.description: Destroys an array returned by proj_get_crs_info_list_from_database and frees associated entries.
requirements: list must be either NULL or a pointer returned by proj_get_crs_info_list_from_database.
Do not access list contents after destruction.

functions.name: proj_get_units_from_database
functions.signature:
PROJ_UNIT_INFO PROJ_DLL **proj_get_units_from_database(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx,
                                                       const char *auth_name,
                                                       const char *category,
                                                       int allow_deprecated,
                                                       int *out_result_count);
functions.description: Retrieves unit definitions from the database for the given authority and (optional) category, returning an array of PROJ_UNIT_INFO*.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
auth_name may be NULL (no restriction) or a valid authority name.
category may be NULL (no restriction) or one of the documented categories (e.g., "linear", "angular", etc.).
allow_deprecated controls inclusion of deprecated units (non-zero to include).
out_result_count must be non-NULL.
Returned array must be freed with proj_unit_list_destroy().
May return NULL on error or no result.

functions.name: proj_unit_list_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a list returned by proj_get_units_from_database and frees associated resources.
requirements: list must be either NULL or a list returned by proj_get_units_from_database.
Do not use list after destruction.

functions.name: proj_insert_object_session_create
functions.description: Creates a new insertion session object used to generate SQL INSERT statements for database objects.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
Returned session must be destroyed with proj_insert_object_session_destroy().
Returns NULL on error.

functions.name: proj_insert_object_session_destroy
functions.description: Destroys an insertion session and frees associated resources.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
session must be a session previously created by proj_insert_object_session_create(), or NULL.
Do not use session after destruction.

functions.name: proj_get_insert_statements
functions.description: Generates SQL INSERT statements representing the provided object for insertion into a database, honoring authority/code and options.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
session must be a valid session created by proj_insert_object_session_create().
object must be a valid PJ* object to serialize.
authority may be NULL or a valid authority name; code may be NULL or a proposed identifier.
numeric_codes is a boolean flag (non-zero to use numeric codes).
allowed_authorities may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of authority names.
options may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of option strings.
Returned list must be freed with proj_string_list_destroy().
Returns NULL on error.

functions.name: proj_suggests_code_for
functions.description: Suggests an authority code for the provided object, optionally constrained to the given authority and numeric/non-numeric preference.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
object must be a valid PJ* object.
authority may be NULL or a valid authority name string.
numeric_code is a boolean flag (non-zero to suggest numeric code).
options may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of option strings.
Returned string must be freed with proj_string_destroy().
Returns NULL on error or if no suggestion.

functions.name: proj_string_destroy
functions.description: Frees a string returned by certain PROJ API functions (e.g., proj_suggests_code_for).
requirements: str must be either NULL or a string previously allocated/returned by a PROJ function documented to be freed with proj_string_destroy().
Do not use str after destruction.

functions.name: proj_create_operation_factory_context
functions.description: Creates an operation factory context to control operation discovery between CRS, optionally scoped to a given authority.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
authority may be NULL or a valid authority name string.
Returned object must be destroyed with proj_operation_factory_context_destroy().

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_destroy
functions.description: Destroys an operation factory context created by proj_create_operation_factory_context.
requirements: ctx must be NULL or a pointer returned by proj_create_operation_factory_context().
Do not use ctx after destruction.

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_desired_accuracy
functions.description: Sets the desired accuracy (in meters) criterion for selecting operations in the factory context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
factory_ctx must be a valid context created by proj_create_operation_factory_context().
accuracy is a double value expressing accuracy requirement (units implied by API; typically meters).

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_area_of_interest
functions.signature:
void PROJ_DLL proj_operation_factory_context_set_area_of_interest(
    PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, PJ_OPERATION_FACTORY_CONTEXT *factory_ctx,
    double west_lon_degree, double south_lat_degree, double east_lon_degree,
    double north_lat_degree);
functions.description: Sets the area of interest bounding box (in degrees) used to filter candidate operations.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
factory_ctx must be a valid PJ_OPERATION_FACTORY_CONTEXT*.
Longitude and latitude values are in degrees as documented parameter names indicate.

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_area_of_interest_name
functions.description: Sets a human-readable area-of-interest name in the factory context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
factory_ctx must be valid.
area_name must be a valid null-terminated string or NULL to clear.

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_crs_extent_use
functions.description: Configures how source/target CRS extents are used when filtering candidate operations.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
factory_ctx must be a valid operation factory context.
use must be a valid PROJ_CRS_EXTENT_USE enum value.

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_spatial_criterion
functions.description: Sets the spatial containment/intersection criterion for evaluating AOI against operation extents.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
factory_ctx must be valid.
criterion must be a valid PROJ_SPATIAL_CRITERION value.

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_grid_availability_use
functions.description: Sets how grid availability influences filtering/sorting of candidate operations.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
factory_ctx must be valid.
use must be a valid PROJ_GRID_AVAILABILITY_USE enum value.

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_use_proj_alternative_grid_names
functions.signature:
void PROJ_DLL
proj_operation_factory_context_set_use_proj_alternative_grid_names(
    PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, PJ_OPERATION_FACTORY_CONTEXT *factory_ctx,
    int usePROJNames);
functions.description: Enables/disables using PROJ alternative grid names during operation discovery.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
factory_ctx must be valid.
usePROJNames is a boolean flag (0/!=0).

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_allow_use_intermediate_crs
functions.description: Controls whether and how intermediate CRS may be used when searching for operations.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
factory_ctx must be valid.
use must be a valid PROJ_INTERMEDIATE_CRS_USE value.

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_allowed_intermediate_crs
functions.description: Sets a whitelist of allowed intermediate CRS as a NULL-terminated list of "AUTH_NAME:CODE" strings.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
factory_ctx must be valid.
list_of_auth_name_codes may be NULL to clear, or a NULL-terminated list of strings.

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_discard_superseded
functions.signature:
void PROJ_DLL proj_operation_factory_context_set_discard_superseded(
    PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, PJ_OPERATION_FACTORY_CONTEXT *factory_ctx, int discard);
functions.description: Controls whether superseded operations should be discarded during discovery.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
factory_ctx must be valid.
discard is a boolean flag (0/!=0).

functions.name: proj_operation_factory_context_set_allow_ballpark_transformations
functions.signature:
void PROJ_DLL proj_operation_factory_context_set_allow_ballpark_transformations(
    PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, PJ_OPERATION_FACTORY_CONTEXT *factory_ctx, int allow);
functions.description: Enables/disables use of ballpark transformations when discovering operations.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
factory_ctx must be valid.
allow is a boolean flag (0/!=0).

functions.name: proj_create_operations
functions.description: Finds candidate coordinate operations between source_crs and target_crs given discovery context, returning a list of operations.
requirements: ctx must be a valid PJ_CONTEXT*.
source_crs and target_crs must be valid PJ* CRS objects.
operationContext may be NULL or a valid PJ_OPERATION_FACTORY_CONTEXT*.
Returned list must be destroyed with proj_list_destroy().
Returns NULL on error or no operations found.

functions.name: proj_list_get_count
functions.description: Returns the number of objects contained in a PJ_OBJ_LIST returned by search functions (e.g., proj_create_operations).
requirements: result must be a valid list returned by a PROJ function like proj_create_operations().

functions.name: proj_list_get
functions.signature:
PJ PROJ_DLL *proj_list_get(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ_OBJ_LIST *result,
                           int index);
functions.description: Retrieves the PJ* object at the specified index from a PJ_OBJ_LIST.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
result must be a valid PJ_OBJ_LIST*.
index must be in the range [0, proj_list_get_count(result) - 1].
Returned object is owned by the list or returned with appropriate lifetime per PROJ semantics (check documentation).

functions.name: proj_list_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a list of PJ objects created by functions like proj_create_operations or proj_create_from_name.
requirements: result must be a list previously returned by a PROJ function or NULL.
Do not access the list after destruction.

functions.name: proj_get_suggested_operation
functions.signature:
int PROJ_DLL proj_get_suggested_operation(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx,
                                          PJ_OBJ_LIST *operations,
                                          PJ_DIRECTION direction,
                                          PJ_COORD coord);
functions.description: Suggests the best operation index from a list for transforming the provided coordinate in the given direction.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
operations must be a valid PJ_OBJ_LIST* of operations.
direction must be one of PJ_FWD, PJ_INV, or PJ_IDENT.
coord is a PJ_COORD value for evaluation.
Returns an index (>=0) on success, or a negative value on error.

functions.name: proj_crs_is_derived
functions.description: Indicates whether the given CRS is a Derived/Projected CRS.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS object.

functions.name: proj_crs_get_geodetic_crs
functions.description: Returns the associated geodetic CRS (geographic/geocentric) of the provided CRS, if any.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS.
Returns NULL if unavailable.

functions.name: proj_crs_get_horizontal_datum
functions.description: Returns the horizontal datum of the CRS, if any (deprecated vs newer naming may apply internally).
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS.
Returns NULL if not applicable.

functions.name: proj_crs_get_sub_crs
functions.signature: PJ PROJ_DLL *proj_crs_get_sub_crs(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *crs, int index);
functions.description: For a compound CRS, returns the sub-CRS at the given index.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS, typically a compound CRS.
index must be within valid range for the number of sub-CRS components.
Returns NULL if not applicable.

functions.name: proj_crs_get_datum
functions.description: Returns the datum associated with the CRS, if any.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS.
Returns NULL if none or not applicable.

functions.name: proj_crs_get_datum_ensemble
functions.description: Returns the datum ensemble of the CRS, if any.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS.
Returns NULL if not applicable.

functions.name: proj_crs_get_datum_forced
functions.description: Returns a datum object for the CRS, forcing a datum representation when needed.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS.

functions.name: proj_crs_has_point_motion_operation
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the CRS has an associated point motion operation (time-dependent components).
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS object.

functions.name: proj_datum_ensemble_get_member_count
functions.description: Returns the number of members in a datum ensemble.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
datum_ensemble must be a valid datum ensemble object.

functions.name: proj_datum_ensemble_get_accuracy
functions.description: Returns the accuracy (in meters) associated with the datum ensemble, or a sentinel if unknown.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
datum_ensemble must be valid.

functions.name: proj_datum_ensemble_get_member
functions.description: Returns a member of a datum ensemble by index.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
datum_ensemble must be valid.
member_index must be within [0, count-1].

functions.name: proj_dynamic_datum_get_frame_reference_epoch
functions.description: Returns the frame reference epoch of a dynamic datum.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
datum must be a valid dynamic datum object.

functions.name: proj_crs_get_coordinate_system
functions.description: Returns the coordinate system object associated with a CRS.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS.
Returns NULL if unavailable.

functions.name: proj_cs_get_type
functions.description: Returns the coordinate system type (e.g., Cartesian, Ellipsoidal).
requirements: ctx must be valid.
cs must be a valid coordinate system object.

functions.name: proj_cs_get_axis_count
functions.description: Returns the number of axes of a coordinate system.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
cs must be a valid coordinate system object.

functions.name: proj_cs_get_axis_info
functions.description: Retrieves information about a specific axis of a coordinate system, including name, direction, and unit details.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
cs must be a valid coordinate system object.
index must be within [0, axis_count-1].
Any out_* pointer may be NULL if the corresponding value is not needed.
Returns non-zero on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: proj_get_ellipsoid
functions.description: Returns the ellipsoid associated with the given object (e.g., CRS or datum), if any.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
obj must be a valid PJ object.
Returns NULL if not available.

functions.name: proj_ellipsoid_get_parameters
functions.signature:
int PROJ_DLL proj_ellipsoid_get_parameters(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *ellipsoid,
                                           double *out_semi_major_metre,
                                           double *out_semi_minor_metre,
                                           int *out_is_semi_minor_computed,
                                           double *out_inv_flattening);
functions.description: Retrieves ellipsoid parameters: semi-major and semi-minor axes (meters), whether semi-minor is computed, and inverse flattening.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
ellipsoid must be a valid ellipsoid object.
Any out_* pointer may be NULL if not needed.
Returns non-zero on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: proj_get_celestial_body_name
functions.description: Returns the celestial body name (e.g., "Earth") associated with the object.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
obj must be valid.
Returned pointer is owned by PROJ and must not be freed by the caller; may be NULL.

functions.name: proj_get_prime_meridian
functions.description: Returns the prime meridian object associated with the given object, if any.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
obj must be valid.
Returns NULL if unavailable.

functions.name: proj_prime_meridian_get_parameters
functions.signature:
int PROJ_DLL proj_prime_meridian_get_parameters(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx,
                                                const PJ *prime_meridian,
                                                double *out_longitude,
                                                double *out_unit_conv_factor,
                                                const char **out_unit_name);
functions.description: Gets prime meridian parameters: longitude (in its unit), conversion factor to SI, and unit name.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
prime_meridian must be a valid prime meridian object.
Any out_* pointer may be NULL if not needed.
Returns non-zero on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: proj_crs_get_coordoperation
functions.description: Returns the coordinate operation (conversion/projection) associated with a CRS, if applicable.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS.
Returns NULL if not applicable.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_get_method_info
functions.description: Retrieves method metadata (name, authority, code) for a coordinate operation.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be a valid coordinate operation object.
Any out_* may be NULL if not needed.
Returns non-zero on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_is_instantiable
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the operation has sufficient information to be instantiated/executed.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be valid.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_has_ballpark_transformation
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the coordinate operation includes a ballpark transformation.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be valid.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_requires_per_coordinate_input_time
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the operation requires a per-coordinate input time (temporal dependency).
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be valid.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_get_param_count
functions.description: Returns the number of parameters for a coordinate operation method.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be valid.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_get_param_index
functions.description: Returns the index of a parameter by its name in a coordinate operation, or negative if not found.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be valid.
name must be a valid null-terminated string.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_get_param
functions.description: Retrieves detailed information about one parameter of a coordinate operation, including name, value (numeric or string), and unit metadata.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be valid.
index must be within [0, param_count-1].
Any out_* may be NULL if not needed.
Returns non-zero on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_get_grid_used_count
functions.description: Returns the number of grids referenced by a coordinate operation.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be valid.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_get_grid_used
functions.description: Retrieves information about a grid used by a coordinate operation: names, package, URL and availability flags.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be valid.
index must be within [0, grid_count-1].
Any out_* may be NULL if not needed.
Returns non-zero on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_get_accuracy
functions.description: Returns the stated accuracy (in meters) of a coordinate operation, or -1 if unknown.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
obj must be a valid coordinate operation object.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_get_towgs84_values
functions.description: Exports the operation as +towgs84 parameters if compatible. Writes up to value_count values into out_values.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
coordoperation must be valid.
out_values must be a valid pointer with capacity for value_count doubles.
value_count must be large enough for the expected +towgs84 form (typically 3/7).
emit_error_if_incompatible controls error reporting when not representable.
Returns non-zero on success, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: proj_coordoperation_create_inverse
functions.description: Creates and returns the inverse of a given coordinate operation, if it is invertible.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
obj must be a valid coordinate operation.
Returns NULL if not invertible or on error.

functions.name: proj_concatoperation_get_step_count
functions.description: Returns the number of steps in a concatenated operation.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
concatoperation must be a valid concatenated operation object.

functions.name: proj_concatoperation_get_step
functions.description: Returns the ith step operation of a concatenated operation.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
concatoperation must be valid.
i_step must be within [0, step_count-1].

functions.name: proj_coordinate_metadata_create
functions.signature:
PJ PROJ_DLL *proj_coordinate_metadata_create(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, const PJ *crs,
                                             double epoch);
functions.description: Creates a CoordinateMetadata object binding a CRS and an observation epoch.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
crs must be a valid CRS object.
epoch is a numeric value (typically decimal year).
Returns NULL on error.

functions.name: proj_coordinate_metadata_get_epoch
functions.description: Gets the epoch associated with a CoordinateMetadata object.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
obj must be a CoordinateMetadata object.

functions.name: proj_create_cs
functions.signature:
PJ PROJ_DLL *proj_create_cs(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx, PJ_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_TYPE type,
                            int axis_count, const PJ_AXIS_DESCRIPTION *axis);
functions.description: Creates a coordinate system object of the specified type and axes.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
type must be a valid PJ_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_TYPE.
axis_count must match the number of entries in axis.
axis must point to an array of axis_count PJ_AXIS_DESCRIPTION entries.
Returns NULL on error.

functions.name: proj_create_cartesian_2D_cs
functions.signature:
PJ PROJ_DLL *proj_create_cartesian_2D_cs(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx,
                                         PJ_CARTESIAN_CS_2D_TYPE type,
                                         const char *unit_name,
                                         double unit_conv_factor);
functions.description: Convenience creator for a 2D Cartesian CS with specified axis ordering and linear unit.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
type must be a valid PJ_CARTESIAN_CS_2D_TYPE.
unit_name must be a valid string naming the unit.
unit_conv_factor is the factor to convert the unit to the SI unit (meter).
Returns NULL on error.

functions.name: proj_create_ellipsoidal_2D_cs
functions.signature:
PJ PROJ_DLL *proj_create_ellipsoidal_2D_cs(PJ_CONTEXT *ctx,
                                           PJ_ELLIPSOIDAL_CS_2D_TYPE type,
                                           const char *unit_name,
                                           double unit_conv_factor);
functions.description: Creates a 2D ellipsoidal CS with chosen axis order and angular unit.
requirements: ctx must be valid.
type must be a valid PJ_ELLIPSOIDAL_CS_2D_TYPE.
